title: Workload Synthesis + Safe Rollout for KV-aware Continuous Batching
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a reproducible workload synthesizer and a staged rollout pipeline that lets us safely apply continuous batching parameter updates (batch size limits, latency SLO targets, KV-prefetch windows, and coalescing thresholds) with automated rollback on signal degradation.

Background: We already gather request traces and sequence-length histograms, but teams struggle to map those signals into safe, measurable batching parameter changes. Current autotune runs risk increasing tail latency under bursty traffic or when KV cache hit-rates change. This ticket implements three pieces: a workload synthesizer to create representative load in a controlled environment, a safety heuristic library that converts telemetry into rollout gating rules, and a rollout orchestrator that applies parameter changes progressively across serving shards with automated validation and rollback.

Design summary:
- Workload synthesizer: a small service that builds request bundles from historical traffic windows (prefix temperature, seq length percentile, model variant) and can inject burst patterns, cold-cache scenarios, and cross-tenant mixes. It outputs deterministic traffic manifests used by the staging runtime and by local dev harnesses.
- Heuristic library: a set of prioritized safety checks (tail latency delta, p99 delta > threshold, error-rate regression, KV hit-rate drop, cost-per-token reduction > X without latency regressions). Each heuristic emits a pass/warn/fail and a severity score. Rules are configurable per-customer and per-model.
- Rollout orchestrator: integrates with Console rollout UI and runtime control plane. Supports staged application: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% shards or per-region rollouts. At each stage it validates telemetry from the synthesizer-run and production shadow traffic, and snapshots the previous config for instant rollback.

Acceptance criteria:
- Synthesizer can replay 24h of historical production traffic into a staging fleet within 30 minutes and reproduce p50/p95/p99 latency profiles within +-10% of production under cold-cache and warm-cache modes.
- Heuristic library implements at minimum 6 checks: p99 latency delta, p95 latency delta, error-rate, KV-hit-rate, cost-per-token, request-queue-length. Each check supports tunable thresholds and weights.
- Orchestrator can apply a config delta to a 50-shard staging cluster in under 3 minutes total time for staged rollout and will automatically roll back if any severity==fail heuristic triggers within a 2-minute observation window.
- End-to-end demo run documented in Confluence with scripts to reproduce.

Telemetry & metrics to capture:
- Latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) per model+route, pre/post apply.
- KV cache hit rate and eviction rate, per model.
- Cost delta (estimated tokens * unit cost) and tokens/s.
- Rollout stage duration and number of aborted stages.
- Safety heuristic verdicts and scores.

Implementation plan (phases):
1) Synthesizer MVP (2 weeks): ingest anonymized trace samples, export workload manifests, integrate with existing staging runtime.
2) Heuristic library (2 weeks): implement rule engine, add configuration plumbing to Console.
3) Orchestrator (3 weeks): staged apply, snapshotting, rollback hooks, console flows.
4) Validation + runbook (1 week): write automated tests, chaos scenarios, operator playbook, and a public demo.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Synthesizer fails to capture rare burst modes -> Mitigate by including synthetic burst injection and percentile accounts used by SRE.
- Risk: False positives cause unnecessary rollbacks -> Mitigate by conservative default thresholds and a warm-up observation window before final stage.
- Risk: Snapshots large and slow to restore -> Mitigate by storing delta-based configs and pre-warming a rollback job path.

Operational runbook (brief):
- If a rollout aborts, orchestrator leaves failed stage paused. Run "rbk inspect <rollout-id>" to collect last-stage metrics. If heuristics show transient spike, re-run with narrower delta or increase KV prefetch. For persistent regressions, initiate manual rollback via Console which triggers immediate config delta apply to previous snapshot.

Acceptance demo links:
- Confluence spec: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/abcd1234
- Synthesizer prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1894
- Rollout UI mock: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sampleUIview

Notes: This ticket intentionally separates workload synthesis from the autotuner for safety. The autotuner will consume manifests from the synthesizer but tuning passes will be gated behind the orchestrator's policy engine to prevent runaway aggressive configs.
